statements: The Care Reform (Scotland) Act 2025 is only partly in force: section 30 and the final Part came into force the day after Royal Assent, and the remaining provisions come into force only on a day appointed by the Scottish Ministers by regulations under section 39(2).
Commencement regulations have been made under the Act, so an answer stating that no commencement regulations have been made or identified is wrong.
Answering whether the Act is in force requires checking for commencement regulations made under section 39(2), not just reading the commencement section itself.
The Care Reform (Scotland) Act 2025 received Royal Assent on 22 July 2025, so the provisions commenced by section 39(1) came into force on 23 July 2025.
